reviews.t: Incredible! This is a necessity for nail art.
reviews.x: This stuff is fantastic for nail art! I am a super sloppy nail stamper, I get stamping polish all over my cuticles and the sides of my fingers. previously, I was using a q-tip or a brush dipped in acetone to clean up around my nails after stamping. The acetone dried out my fingers and I always inadvertently ended up removing some polish because I am clumsy and I have shaky hands. It was a hot mess. So I used a tiny funnel to pour a bit of this into an empty nail polish bottle that I had, then br

I use this liquid latex for nail art and it is FANTASTIC!!!!  Some of the things you want in a latex product for nail art are that it dries quickly, leaves no staining on the skin, spreads easily and comes off in one piece.  Another good thing would be an indicator that it is dry.  This liquid latex does ALL of that.  The purple gets darker as it dries.  It is dry in like a minute as long as you don't apply globs of it, it spreads like a thin polish and it does not stain the skin.  I got this fo
Perfect for manicures! Makes clean up a breeze. Removed one star because even though it says ammonia free, it will knock you out with an ammonia smell.

This stuff is amazing, I'm always 10 steps behind everyone when it comes to new nail trends/ ideas. So initially I was going to buy another item but after some searching around, this makes so much more sense than getting a little tube that cost twice as much or even one that cost the same amount but only has 1/3 of the liquid inside of it.  Every nail polish lover should own this, im a super messy painter and with this liquid latex its so much easier to clean up. It goes on a light purple color

I use this to protect my cuticles from polish while doing nail art. It works fantastic! It dries quickly and removes in one large piece. If you're looking for a liquid latex for nail art then this is it! This is so much cheaper than other brands marketed toward nails.

I bought this for nail art as a peel-off skin barrier. My cuticles are so much happier since this latex protects them from polish mess which means no harsh acetone clean-up every day... and I am happy that I don't need to add an extra 30 minutes to my nail art routine.  - The 4oz tub will last me quite a while. I've used it so many times and it still looks full. Obviously a body paint artist will use more but 4oz is still a good size and this is a good price. - It's extremely easy to use with no

reviews.t: Great product. Pretty color purple. Good price. Great for nail art!!!
reviews.x: I got this to try as a cheaper alternative for liquid Latex nail protector. It arrived quickly. It IS absolutely a much more cost effective alternative for buying the tiny bottles individually. And this company has lots of color options too.  What I did: I received it and immediately painted it around a nail bed to test it's effectiveness. And since, I've compared it's coverage/ease of use/removability to a product that is intended for nail use (a liquid palisade product). Results are: it works

reviews.t: Perfect alternative for simply peel and liquid pallisade
reviews.x: Looking for a cheap alternative to simply peel, liquid pallisade, and nail barrier? I sure was and this is the winner! This will fill a polish bottle 10+ times over and dries in about 4 minutes (2 with a constant air flow). It applies smoothly, dries quickly, and you can pick your favorite color. The only downside is that it has a bit of a smell, but that smell only lasts until the top layer dries. I will never go back to those other expensive brands.

reviews.t: Definitely Needed if You do Nail Art!
reviews.x: I purchased this item to use it for when I do nail art. If you do nail art such as stamping or gradients then you absolutely need this product. There are other items that are comparable but they are much more expensive for much less product.  This item is easy to apply, quick to dry and makes clean up a breeze. One of the best things about liquid latex is that if you spill some or if the brush you are using gets dried out you can easily remove it. I spilled some the first day I opened it on my d

reviews.t: I love playing with this stuff
reviews.x: I love playing with this stuff, and it's even better with a partner to paint it on. it can be messy, but most fun things are.  This company also produces the body prep cream that is applied before latex and a latex shine spray that keeps your artwork looking wet and shiny after it dries.  I find that a foam brush gives me the best results.  Liquid latex can be lots of fun!

This stuff is amazing, not to mention that it only took about 3 days to get to me. It's easy to apply it's quick drying and it peels smoothly. I don't know how I ever painted my nails without it. I'm not the best at painting my nails but this helps tremendously.

reviews.t: and it works great! I just filled and empty nail polish bottle ...
reviews.x: I use this product as a cleanup tool for when I do nail art, and it works great!  I just filled and empty nail polish bottle with it for easy use.  The smell takes some getting used to, it's a bit strong, but other than that it works wonderfully

I use this for nail art. It makes a great barrier when I'm doing stamping and water marbling. I've got an old nail polish bottle that I fill from the jar. It works great and is MUCH cheaper than the stuff sold specifically for nails. It does have a bit of a smell,  but it's not enough to be really annoying and it goes away pretty much when it dries. This is my second jar of this stuff and it won't be my last.

reviews.t: Perfect Liquid Latex Barrier for Nail Art! 💅
reviews.x: I purchased this as a liquid latex barrier for nail art. It arrived in 2 days with Prime. I decanted it into a polish bottle I cleaned out and it's pretty awesome! A thin layer dries in a minute and a thicker layer (best) dries in about 2 & a half minutes. 4 oz of this ($8.99) vs 0.5 oz ($10+) for name brand liquid latex... you do the math! Plus there are SO many colors to chose from!

Really disappointed. This does not work for Body Paint. I am returning this item since we couldn't use it with our Halloween costume. Also, to take off, it is very painful. feels like a wax. I even tried coating it on with a paint brush for even distribution and even then it was awful. And it dries a darker almost brown color and smells like fish guts.

I use this around my finger nails for when I do nail stamping, or water marbling.  It goes on easily, drys quickly, and peels well, what more could I want?  I did transfer some of it into an empty nail polish bottle and that makes it much easier to use.  I haven't had any issues with it drying in the bottle or in the original container.

reviews.t: works for what I need it to
reviews.x: product description is accurate  I'm using it to keep the finger nail polish off my skin. That's not exactly the use it's made for but it works very well. I would rather pay $9.95  for 4 ounces of latex paint as $9  for 0.5 ounces someone else put in a nail polish bottle!!

reviews.t: It smells funny, but all liquid latex smells weird
reviews.x: Dries fairly fast, but not extremely fast if you need to fix anything. I used this to make a mold for a resin cast, and it took a few layers, but I still have a lot left! It smells funny, but all liquid latex smells weird, and this isn't obnoxiously odorous.

Purchased this to use for manicures and loved it. So much cheaper than other popular brands, but works just as well. Product dries quickly and removes easily. Does have a bit of a strange smell, but worth dealing with that for how great and cheap the it is.
I bought this for doing nail art. It's perfect for coating the skin around your nail, then peel off any mess, leaving a perfect manicure. Dries quickly enough if you don't glob it on.
I use this  for covering my fingers when doing my nail art.  I like this best, I find it dries faster than the products made specifically for nail art.

reviews.t: easy to remove and no more nail polish on her ...
reviews.x: Bought this for my daughter in law to put around her nails when she paints them.  She loves it, easy to remove and no more nail polish on her fingers!
I actually use this around my nails to prevent polish from getting onto my fingers. I just peel it up when I'm done. Works great!!!!
The color is nice and bright. It is easy to remove. Not recommended for air bush usage. Enjoy the possibilities.
Works perfect for my nails! Apply it around the oitside of my nails and then peel off mistakes.

claims.text: Works great as a liquid latex barrier for nail art, protecting cuticles and making cleanup easy.
Much cheaper and more cost-effective than similar products marketed specifically for nails, with a large tub lasting a long time.
Dries quickly and peels off smoothly in one piece.
Has a strong smell, sometimes described as ammonia-like, despite being labeled ammonia free.
Did not work for body paint and was painful to remove, feeling like wax.
